headline: Duran and Contreras smash the Royals as the bats finally wake up
morning_brew: Last night in Kansas City was a beautiful sight for anyone tired of watching this offense sleepwalk through May. Jarren Duran was absolutely flying out there, hitting a home run, a double, and driving in three runs to lead the charge. Willson Contreras kept his hot streak alive with two hits and three runs batted in of his own. We racked up fifteen hits as a team and did not commit a single error. I think we got something here if these guys can keep this momentum going, especially with a two-game winning streak in our pockets.

Ranger Suarez did not have his deepest outing, going four and a third innings, but he kept us in the game by surrendering only one run. The bullpen was absolutely lights out after he departed, allowing just two hits over the rest of the game. Garrett Whitlock earned the win with a clean eighth inning, and Jovani Moran slammed the door by striking out the side in the ninth. When the arms and the bats actually decide to show up on the same night, this team is actually fun to watch.

Meanwhile, the NFL schedule makers are already trying to get us hyped up with a Week 1 matchup against Seattle. Hearing about a Super Bowl rematch gets the blood pumping, but we are a long way from those championship days. Drake Maye has a lot of work to do with this offense, and I just want to see some competitive football when September rolls around. It is a long offseason in Foxborough, but at least we have something real to look forward to.

news_digest.headline: Patriots and Seahawks set for thrilling Super Bowl rematch
news_digest.dans_take: A Week 1 battle with Seattle is going to be a massive early test for Drake Maye and this young squad.
